SCIENCE.title: Ветеринары сравнили, как сухой, влажный и свежий корма сказались на микробиоме кошек
SCIENCE.desc: Состав пищи влияет не только на то, какие питательные вещества получает организм, но и на микроорганизмы, обитающие в пищеварительном тракте. Изменения в их сообществе могут отражать особенности питания, хотя…
SCIENCE.fullText:
Кишечный микробиом — это совокупность бактерий и других микроорганизмов, населяющих пищеварительную систему. Они участвуют в переработке пищи, обмене веществ и работе иммунной системы. На состав этого сообщества влияет рацион, но пока ученые не до конца понимают, какие именно изменения связаны с улучшением здоровья животных. В частности, сравнительно мало данных о том, как на микробиом кошек воздействует свежий корм, проходящий более мягкую термическую обработку, чем обычные консервы.

Чтобы восполнить этот пробел, ветеринары из Университета Флориды (США) сравнили три рациона: сухой, влажный и свежий. В эксперименте участвовали 15 здоровых стерилизованных кошек в возрасте от двух до шести лет. Каждое животное последовательно, по 14 дней, получало все три вида корма. Рационы были полноценными и имели в основе курицу. Порядок определяли случайным образом, а весь эксперимент занял 42 дня. 

Свежим кормом выбрали KatKin Cluck, который подвергают умеренной термической обработке. Для сравнения использовали сухой Purina One и влажный Fancy Feast. В последние три дня каждого периода медики…

SCIENCE.title: Зрачки выдали людей, пытавшихся мухлевать с картами
SCIENCE.desc: По глазам можно заметить не только то, куда смотрит человек, но и какую информацию он пытается скрыть. Эксперимент психологов показал: старания обмануть собеседника не всегда позволяют контролировать…
SCIENCE.fullText:
Способность распознавать ложь остается сложной задачей даже в специально организованных условиях. Один из подходов к ее решению — тест на скрываемую информацию: человеку показывают изображения или задают вопросы, связанные с тем, что ему известно, затем отслеживают физиологические реакции. Если среди нейтральных стимулов появляется знакомый, он может вызвать непроизвольную реакцию.

Психологи из Ульмского Университета в Германии проверили, удастся ли заметить такие признаки обмана не только при взаимодействии с компьютером, но и в разговоре с другим человеком. Статью об этом опубликовали в журнале PLOS One.

В эксперименте участвовали 37 добровольцев — 21 женщина и 16 мужчин, cредний возраст которых составил 34,8 года. Добровольцев просили представить, что они играют с менталистом, который пытается угадать их выбор. Сначала на экране появлялись шесть карт с цифрами от одного до шести. Нужно было выбрать одну из них и запомнить. Потом исследователи предлагали три сценария: честно раскрыть выбор, скрыть его или убедить наблюдателя, что была выбрана другая карта.

Роль менталиста играл…

Для описания процессов, включающих повторяющиеся социальные взаимодействия, разрабатываются так называемые агентно-ориентированные модели. Учет особенностей реальных участников может повысить точность прогноза, а вместе с тем и эффективность расчета вероятных рисков. В плане экономических процессов за последние десятилетия возникли теории, значительно более точно представляющие поведение людей, по сравнению с классическими экономическими теориями. С опорой на эту теоретическую базу авторы разработали модель агента для повторяющихся игр, которая, помимо материального выигрыша, учитывает внутренние оценки исхода взаимодействия.

SCIENCE.fullText:
В рамках всероссийского исследования «Готовность россиян к технологиям будущего» участникам предложили ответить на вопрос: «На ваш взгляд, в будущем Россия сможет или не сможет успешно конкурировать с США и Китаем в области космических технологий и освоения космоса?»

В успешную конкуренцию России с двумя космическими державами верят 67% опрошенных. Из них 33% определенно уверены в такой возможности, еще 34% скорее придерживаются этой точки зрения. Противоположное мнение высказали 19% участников исследования: 12% скорее не верят в успешную конкуренцию, семь процентов определенно не верят. Примерно 15% затруднились ответить или отказались от ответа.

Наиболее оптимистично перспективы отечественной космонавтики оценили представители старшего поколения. Среди участников в возрасте 60 лет и старше в успех России верят 72%. В группе от 45 до 59 лет этот показатель составляет 67%, среди 30-44-летних — 65%, а среди молодежи от 18 до 29 лет — 59%.

GAMES.title: Rockstar workers vote overwhelmingly against union recognition
GAMES.desc: The IWGB says efforts will continue, but with only 25% of Rockstar workers voting in favor, there's a long way to go.
GAMES.fullText:
After two weeks of voting that bracketed the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, Rockstar Games employees have voted overwhelmingly against a recognition agreement with the IWGB Game Workers Union. 
 25% of Rockstar employees voted in favor of the recognition agreement, the union said, while 75% voted against it. 1,544 employees took part in the vote, representing a turnout of just over 93%.
 Rockstar workers actually founded a union earlier this year—the Rockstar Game Workers Union, a subsidiary of the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain—and it will continue to operate as it has. The IWGB said the outcome will not prevent Rockstar workers from organizing or exercising union rights, but the company will not be required to regularly meet with union representatives for collective bargaining or other relevant matters. 
 Despite the vote, the union said it will continue with organizing efforts at Rockstar.
 "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society—this isn’t a sign to retreat, it’s a sign to double down on what we stand for.…

GAMES.title: The latest adult game in the Muv-Luv series has some woeful AI translation and players aren't happy about it
GAMES.desc: The store page boasts "over 800,000 copies sold worldwide" but user reviews have sunk to Mostly Negative.
GAMES.fullText:
The Muv-Luv trilogy is a visual novel phenomenon that's tough to explain. The first game's a schlocky high school romance generally considered a chore to get through before the good stuff, when the protagonist of that story finds himself out of his depth as a mecha pilot fighting aliens in an apocalyptic warzone. It becomes a dense, twisty, and increasingly serious saga that just happens to star a dropkick hero right out of a harem anime.
 Muv-Luv's popular enough to have a bunch of spin-offs, the latest being a gacha game called Muv-Luv Girls Garden in which you collect girls to pilot mecha in automated battles, and of course said girls are romanceable. This caused a problem, as players discovered when they made it to some of the adult scenes only to find dialogue in which characters repeated at each other, "I can't provide a translation for explicit sexual content."

GAMES.title: GTA 6 has weird purple streetlights because actual Florida screwed up its streetlights
GAMES.desc: Rockstar recreated an embarrassing mishap in Florida infrastructure.
GAMES.fullText:
When you're exploring a world as realistic and well-observed as GTA 6's Leonida, it's rare for a piece of benign infrastructure to stick out. But on night one of my playthrough, I clocked some weird streetlights.
 Why are some of them turquoise? 

 (Image credit: Rockstar) And hey, why are these purple?
 Rockstar Rockstar A stylistic choice by Rockstar? Maybe, but it's awfully specific, and I had a feeling there was a deeper intention behind it. So I DMed my buddy Henry, an honest-to-god Floridian who was also playing GTA 6, and asked what's up. At first he thought strange streetlights in the Key Lento area of the map were special lights meant to not disorient turtles, but those are typically red, so probably not. And that doesn't explain the purple ones.
 So Henry reached out to friends in south Florida, the region that Leonida's biggest cities are based on, and they cracked the case wide open.
 "The purple [lights] are definitely real. We have a ton of them down here because whoever is in charge of that in the government bought a bunch of defective lights," the anonymous Floridian…

If you've played over a hundred hours of Vampire Survivors you've probably forgotten how slow its early progression feels. It certainly seemed that way based on the reaction to Warhammer Survivors from Vampire Survivors veterans, who complained about its grindiness compared to their beloved bullet heaven originator, despite the arc of both games being quite similar. Developers Auroch Digital made Warhammer Survivors in partnership with Vampire Survivors creator Poncle, so of course the two games have a lot in common.

GAMES.title: Capcom's quirky dinosaur-fighting hero shooter is shutting down in 2027
GAMES.desc: Exoprimal was intriguing, but it never caught fire with players.
GAMES.fullText:
"Exoprimal is a throwback to weird, experimental early 2000s Capcom ," we wrote of the team-based hero shooter ahead of its launch back in 2023. While ostensibly about battling dinosaurs, "you first go through an interdimensional time portal controlled by a rogue AI, and then you compete in a Hunger Games-style contest against alternate universe versions of yourself for the AI's amusement. That's where the dinosaur killing comes in."
 Despite that intriguing premise, the end result was not particularly memorable: Perfectly fine, and with some fantastic ideas, but "more like an early access phase than a finished game," we wrote in our 69% review . And it didn't catch on: A year later, Capcom announced the end of new updates for the game, although the game remained fully playable.
 But now that's changing too. Capcom announced today that Exoprimal services will be terminated on September 29, 2027 , at which point the game will become unplayable. "We cannot thank you enough for the love and support you have shown over the years," Capcom wrote, "and we sincerely apologize for the…

GAMES.title: Trump admin didn't investigate Jensen Huang before pushing Nvidia to bring him back: 'What does that mean, had Huang been investigated? For what?'
GAMES.desc: Nvidia is also not under investigation, according to US Attorney General Todd Blanche.
GAMES.fullText:
US President Donald Trump told CNBC on Monday that he'd given Nvidia "assurance" that ousted and now reinstated CEO Jensen Huang did not represent a national security threat despite an affair with a woman who was reportedly in contact with China's top spy agency. 
 Trump provided that assurance without any formal investigation into Huang's dealings. 
 On whether Huang had been investigated, US Attorney General Todd Blanche said during a press conference this week, "I don't want to talk about investigation. What does that mean, had Huang been investigated? For what? I don't understand the question."
 Blanche also said that he did not know about any export control investigation related to Nvidia, even though potential violations of export control law are the central concern of the scandal.
 "A critical national security threat in the Nvidia situation is that Jensen Huang shipped extremely advanced chips to China, violating US export control law, in what amounts to the equivalent of selling rocket engines to the Soviets during the Space Race," Senate minority leader Chuck Schumer said…

GAMES.title: GTA 6 vault: How to open them during big bank jobs
GAMES.desc: You can make well over $100,000 in a single crime if you open the bank vault and safe deposit boxes.
GAMES.fullText:
Opening a GTA 6 bank vault is one of the best ways to make off with a big score during a robbery, with potentially $100,000 or more in bills and valuables from a single heist. 
 But those huge bank vault doors are completely impenetrable, and confusingly, even after you've learned how to drill into a vault as part of a Chapter 3 story mission , you still won't be able to open vault doors in open world bank robberies.
 Here's the trick: you've got to get someone to open bank vault doors for you. Only then can you steal all that sweet cash.
 HOW TO OPEN A BANK VAULT 
 Complete jobs for Yasmani
 Your GTA 6 fence , Yasmani, will begin offering you tips once you start selling him stolen goods in Chapter 3: jewelry store heists targeting specific items and which ATM jobs have the most cash, for example. These are worth doing anyway as they get you the snap gun .

GAMES.title: Deceased BBC football commentator resurrected with AI for EA Sports FC: The family says it's a 'touching tribute' but some fans call it 'gross' and 'bleak'
GAMES.desc: Legendary football pundit John Motson will return to the series, in AI form, in today's EA FC 27 title update.
GAMES.fullText:
Legendary BBC football commentator John "Motty" Motson, who died in 2023 at age 77, is being added to EA Sports FC 27 through "a mix of both his original audio and an AI-recreation trained by recordings of the man himself." The AI-powered recreation of Motson's distinctive voice has the blessing of his family, but some fans of the game are less than enthused.
 Motson's history with EA's football series goes back more than 30 years, to FIFA Soccer 96 (which came out in 1995). His last game in that series was FIFA Soccer 2005, according to Mobygames , but he continued to work with EA Sports on the FIFA Manager series. The announcement of his posthumous return to the series says "almost 10 years of in-game recordings" were used in conjunction with "new AI tools" to put Motson's voice in EA FC 27.
 "My father adored being the voice of the game, and we are so grateful to the team at EA Sports FC for this touching tribute and preserving his memory in-game," John's son Fred said. "His voice inspired millions of players across generations every time they picked up a controller, and now a…

GAMES.title: As the US Treasury suffers a cybersecurity breach, its chief tech guy is vibecoding a Civilization clone
GAMES.desc: The DOGE alum Treasury CIO says his passion project is "so cool."
GAMES.fullText:
This week, amidst ongoing service disruptions, the US Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) disclosed that it is "investigating a cybersecurity incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems." The bureau, which collects and analyzes transaction data to combat financial crimes, says it has taken some of its e-filing systems offline "as a proactive measure."
 FinCEN hasn't provided an estimate of when the investigation and system disruptions will be resolved, leaving the ability of financial institutions to report suspicious activity and interface with law enforcement indefinitely hampered. Meanwhile, as FinCEN is putting out fires, US Treasury chief information officer Sam Corcos has been busying himself with a different kind of work: He's been vibecoding a Civilization clone.

GAMES.desc: At first the kids jostle to get to the games that they know. "Welcome to the Retro Reset Bus," says Luke Stoner as the students push to get to the screen that’s caught their eye. Sonic on the Sega Mega…
GAMES.fullText:
At first the kids jostle to get to the games that they know. "Welcome to the Retro Reset Bus," says Luke Stoner as the students push to get to the screen that’s caught their eye. Sonic on the Sega Mega Drive is the first they see, and the quickest student to get on board the bus looks triumphant as he nabs the stool in front of the console. Jason, Luke’s dad, asks him what he thinks about the graphics – slightly grainy and slightly pixelated – but he’s not at all bothered and soon engrossed. After a few minutes, though, his eyes keep moving to the back of the bus where "Jackson is a wally" is now emblazoned across a flickering screen in seven different colours. Jackson then gives out a chuffed yell when his code finally works after a couple of restarts. His retort to his mate appears on the 1981 BBC Micro Model B‘s screen as the other students crane to have a look. This is, incidentally, the machine that turned a national broadcaster into a computer retailer (with help from Acorn), says Jason.

They're going to build on the example of Total War: Three Kingdoms , which does allow for some gratifying backroom dealing, in fairness. During my first Thringdoms runthrough, I played Cao Cao, a ruler gifted with the ability to hypnotise people into liking him while hating each other. I spent many idle hours instigating proxy wars. GAMES.fullText: На этой неделе — Terminus: Day Zero, Arctic Drive и Arkheron, а также несколько необычных инди-новинок. Среди них — Light of Atlantis, Reshine, Shark Mart и Appulse. Не забываем и про российские проекты: «МурЗавод» и «В час ночи по московскому времени». Собрали все релизы недели с 23 по 29 ноября в одном календаре.
